title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling
abstract: arXiv:2604.11578v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) is a framework for quantum information processing in which a computational task is carried out through one-qubit measurements on a highly entangled resource state. Due to the indeterminacy of the outcomes of a quantum measurement, the random outcomes of these operations, if not corrected, yield a variational quantum channel family. Traditionally, this randomness is corrected through classical processing in order to ensure deterministic unitary computations. Recently, variational measurement-based quantum computation (VMBQC) has been introduced to exploit this measurement-induced randomness to gain an advantage in generative modeling. A limitation of this approach is that the corresponding channel model has twice as many parameters compared to the unitary model, scaling as $N \times D$, where $N$ is the number of logical qubits (width) and $D$ is the depth of the VMBQC model. translated_title: 用于生成建模的变分测量量子计算中的经典资源最小化
translated_abstract: 测量量子计算是一种量子信息处理框架，其中计算任务通过对高度纠缠的资源态执行单量子比特测量来实现。由于量子测量结果的不确定性，这些操作的随机结果若不加校正，将形成一个变分量子信道族。传统上，这种随机性需要通过经典处理加以校正，以确保确定性的幺正计算。最近，变分测量量子计算（VMBQC）被提出，利用这种测量引起的随机性在生成建模中获得优势。该方法的一个局限是，相应的信道模型相比幺正模型具有两倍的参数量，其规模为 $N \times D$，其中 $N$ 是逻辑量子比特的数量（宽度），$D$ 是 VMBQC 模型的深度。这可能……
tldr: 本文针对变分测量量子计算（VMBQC）中信道模型参数量是幺正模型两倍的局限，提出了最小化经典资源消耗的方案，使生成建模中的经典处理开销得到显著降低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scheme to minimize classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation (VMBQC) for generative modeling, addressing the limitation that the channel model requires twice as many parameters as the unitary model.
